summary: lineinfile's validate runs a command against a temp file via %s before replacing the original; shell features aren't available.
questions: How do I validate sudoers before lineinfile saves it?
Can I use a pipe in lineinfile validate?

answer_card.title: lineinfile validate
answer_card.answer_md: `validate`: command run on a temp copy with `%s` (required), e.g. `/usr/sbin/visudo -cf %s`. No shell expansion or pipes.
